_about: The one place GenClass plans are defined. telemetry-worker/src/plans.ts imports this file (limits, entitlements, Stripe lookup keys, the billing page) and site/build.py reads it (the pricing page). scripts/stripe-setup.mjs creates the Stripe products and prices from it. Prices are US cents. A null yearly price means no yearly option yet. limits.apps null means no plan limit (the worker still caps an account at 200 apps against abuse). Free has no dashboard: its limits are what an account without a plan or trial keeps collecting for (3 apps), so a trial or a plan starts with recent data. A trial (TRIAL_DAYS in telemetry-worker/wrangler.toml, never in public copy) gives Pro's entitlements. Feature lines with available false are shown as coming next. stripe_tax_code is the Stripe product tax code scripts/stripe-setup.mjs sets on the plan's product; managed_payments true sells the plan through Stripe Managed Payments (Stripe, through Link, is the merchant of record; only for fully automated digital products, so Custom, which a person trains, is false; telemetry-worker/README.md, Paid plans).
footer: Need self-hosting, SSO or invoices? Email mehar@daybot.ca.

plans.name: Free
plans.summary: The open-source runtime and its on-device model, without the dashboard.

features.text: The open-source runtime (Apache-2.0) with every mode: observe, guard and heal
Reports in the browser console, or sent to your own webhook or function

plans.name: Pro
plans.summary: The dashboard for every app, a year of history, export and forwarding.

features.text: The dashboard: what GenClass found in each app, on which pages, and what it did
Full data export: every event GenClass received for your apps, as JSONL or CSV, by download or API
Forward detections to Sentry, PostHog, Datadog, Slack or a signed webhook

plans.name: Custom
plans.summary: Pro, plus a GenClass model trained on your own app.

features.text: A classifier trained for your app: we train a GenClass model on your app's own traffic and bug reports and ship it as a private model your runtime loads
A person from GenClass emails you within 1 business day of purchase to start
